_comment: ESP32-P4 host + ESP32-C5 coprocessor core board. Mirrors examples/power_save/host+cp/network_split__host_deep_sleep_cp_light_sleep/{esp_host,cp}/sdkconfig.defaults.p4-c5-core-board. The board symbol alone is not enough: this P4 is rev v1.3 (REV_LESS_V3 + REV_MIN_0) and its console is USB-Serial/JTAG, without which the port prints nothing and the board looks dead.

ot_spinel_uart._comment: Dedicated spinel UART for standard OpenThread / Zigbee on the board's bus lines D2 (P4 53 <-> C5 14) and D3 (P4 52 <-> C5 13). They are free only while ESP-Hosted runs on 2-line SPI-HD (CS, CLK, D0, D1).
